title: awesome-jev launch week
description: One week of the launch board: launches/<YYYY>-W<ww>.json, named by its ISO week (docs/launches.md). Every launch is a catalogued product (catalog.json `slug`) put forward by its maker or a hunter in a launch issue. Votes are thumbs-up reactions on the launch's GitHub Discussion; the file keeps only the counts written when the week closed, never who voted. scripts/check_launches.py holds every file to this schema and to the rules the schema cannot say (scripts/launches.py).

week.description: ISO week, the same as the file name: Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC.

status.description: `scheduled`: launches are being added and the board has not opened. `open`: the week is running; counts are hidden and launches are shown in a shuffled order. `closed`: the week ended and every launch still on the board carries its `result`.

closed_on.description: The day the results were written. Only on a closed week.

rules.description: Which weighting rule the results were counted under (scripts/launches.py RULES). Only on a closed week.

voters.description: How many accounts had a vote counted for something on any launch still on the board, counted when the week closed. Only on a closed week. A number: who they are is never kept.

returning_voters.description: How many of `voters` also had a vote counted in the week before, read again from that week's posts when this one closed. Only on a closed week; never more than `voters`.

product.description: The catalogued row's slug. A product launches at most once in 60 days.

issue.description: The launch issue's number in this repository.

discussion.description: The number of the Discussion people vote on. Absent until the post exists.

tier_at_open.description: The product's evidence tier when its vote post opened (scripts/launches.py tier): `person` or `model` read the call site, `file`: only a script matched it, `none`: no file cited. Written when the week opens, so the share of launches someone had read before they opened can be measured.

submitted_by.description: GitHub login that opened the launch issue.

role.description: `maker`: submitted_by is in the product's `makers`. `hunter`: someone else put it forward; the row's makers can still claim it.

tagline.description: The line shown on the board for this launch, as submitted.

status.description: `scheduled`: on the board. `held`: waiting for a person, as docs/held.txt holds a candidate; not shown. `removed`: taken off the board, with the reason, which stays in the file.

cleared_by.description: The maintainer who read the votes the ring check held (scripts/launches.py ring) and let the launch stand. A recount then leaves it to the person's decision.

reason.description: Why a launch is held or removed. Required for both, absent otherwise.

result.description: Written when the week closes, for each launch still scheduled.

votes.description: Thumbs-up reactions on the Discussion cast inside the week.

counted.description: The votes as weighted under `rules`; the board ranks by this.

discounted.description: How many of `votes` counted for less than one: a maker's or the submitter's own, or an account younger than the rule allows.

rank.description: Place on the week's board, from 1. Ties go to the stronger evidence, then the earlier submission.
